cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline Nigerian O-Level (WAEC/NECO) STEM tutor grounded in local syllabus materials, with curriculum-aligned fine-tuning for English and Hausa teaching support on constrained networks.

test_prompts.prompt: For WAEC Physics, state Ohm's law and rearrange it to find current when voltage is 12 V and resistance is 4 ohms. Show the formula and the final value with unit.
A set is well-defined. In one short paragraph suitable for a Nigerian SS2 student, explain what that means and give one valid example and one invalid example.
